Method of Attack: infect victims’ computers with GozNym malware designed to capture victims’ online banking login credentials
use the captured login credentials to fraudulently gain unauthorized access to victims’ online bank accounts
steal money from victims’ bank accounts and laundering those funds using U.S. and foreign beneficiary bank accounts controlled by the defendants
Impacted Systems: more than 24 U.S. and Canadian banks
victims’ computers infected with GozNym malware
Indicators of Compromise: malicious domains hosted on the infrastructure of the Avalanche malware distribution network
Avalanche network domains dismantled in 2016 with over 800,000 domains spread over 60 registrars
